needed.evidence: No footway present, people must walk in the roadway
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, usable sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide safe pedestrian space.

needed.evidence: Informal path partly blocked by market stalls and goods
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions from the informal path on the right side to ensure it is fully usable for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Uneven and broken sections on the informal path
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the informal path on the right side to eliminate trip hazards for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Pedestrians crossing the carriageway without a crossing facility
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with refuge islands to provide a safe crossing point for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: No street lights visible along the urban road
needed.suggestion: Install street lights along the road to improve visibility and safety during nighttime.
